Sentence (English): There were days when I thought there was no need for a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ There were days when I thought there was no need for a dishwasher. High praise from friends around me. ] || ---------------- || There were days when I thought there was no need for a dishwasher. I lived with my ears closed to the rave reviews of people around me. Even now, I am experiencing a new world by bringing a dishwasher into my home. My aunt is the last of my three aunts to have a dishwasher. I wondered if I really needed this, but now that I have it in the house, it is so convenient. Even the parts that I missed, the dishwasher aunt was pouting even when I looked at her this way and that. I should have bought it a long time ago. Reflect on myself from the past. 12 people, 14 people, even if the family is small, there is a lot of tableware, so if the money difference is not much, I will buy the bigger one, so I decided to buy 14 people. For Glam, I chose Kota White because I heard that it shows well with handprints. After remodeling the dishwasher cabinet, the dishwasher was installed within 30 minutes the next day, and after receiving explanations from the technician, I tried using it right away. First of all, there is less noise when using the dishwasher, and because it has three stages, you can easily turn large dishes and dishes in the dishwasher. Also, there is a low noise mode at night, so you don't know if the dishwasher is working or not when you turn it. I think the fact that it was so quiet and surprising had its merits :) #Participating in the Samsung Braille event

Sentence (English): Purchased a Bosch dishwasher in Annapolis MD a few years ago.
Comments (English): [ Sound level not as advertised ] || ---------------- || Purchased a Bosch dishwasher in Annapolis MD a few years ago. Nice and quiet, washed the dishes perfectly, with no issues. Just purchased a newer model in Sarasota that is rated at 46 dB. Washes the dishes with no issues but using two independent sound level meters, during the wash cycle with the dishwasher full, the two independent sound level meters were held within about 1 ft away. Both meters measured between 60 and 70 dB, with an average of 62dB (see attached photo of one of the meters) . Standing in my living room about 10 feet away, the sound level averaged around 55dB. Contacted the appliance company, followed by contacting the Bosch area representative. Received a call back from the area representative office within a couple of days. Office clerk was going to inform the area manager. Two weeks later, no one has called to come to the home to investigate. After paying around $1200, I expected a quieter dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I have only just installed the dishwasher so it is early days.
Comments (English): [ Good balance between value and quality ] || ---------------- || I have only just installed the dishwasher so it is early days. I bought it because quality is high at a not unreasonable price and my experience with other Bosch's products has been positive. We have been using the new dishwasher for about 2 weeks , and so far it is miles better than our old dishwasher. Sentence (English): This dishwasher is very quiet and looks nice.
Comments (English): [ Factory Mistake! ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is very quiet and looks nice. It seems to work well. The salesperson and store that i bought it from were vere nice and helpful. My only complaint is the fact I wasted 3hrs of my time due to the factory's mistake. I took special care to install perfectly myself. When i went to run for the 1st time, it did nothing then error coded for no H2O. Upon watching videos and Kitchenaid faq's we determined a service visit was needed. They felt water inlet valve was bad. They couldn't come for 3 days so i decided to check it out myself. Low and behold, i found the valve and determined no wires were even hooked to it. Upon further inspection, i found a wire harness and clip just hanging there near the motor. Sure enough, it was the connector that clips to the water inlet valve (Not possible to accidentally fall off, Safety clipped). It was never connected at the factory. After the reinstall, it worked perfectly. What a hassle!

Incredibly quiet, very good washing performance (at least with higher end detergent), and relatively clear, interface and straightforward cycle options. Lots of features, but many we haven't used (bottle wash jets, steam sanitizing). Where we have some concerns is ultimate durability - the racks and other moving parts feel a bit flimsy, there's a lot rather thin plastic parts, and the overall feel is not solid. That said, there's been no cause for complaint, yet. In fact, of the three Profile appliances we bought for a kitchen remodel, this one is the standout, exceeding expectations, unlike the induction range/oven (just OK) and the Advantium “combo-oven”, which does nothing well and has been a huge disappointment - but that's another review. Comments (English): [ Better than good, almost great ] || ---------------- || Make this 4.5 stars - it's great but not perfect. We've had it for almost a year, and it's been completely dependable, performing as advertised. Incredibly quiet, very good washing performance (at least with higher end detergent), and relatively clear, interface and straightforward cycle options. Lots of features, but many we haven't used (bottle wash jets, steam sanitizing). Where we have some concerns is ultimate durability - the racks and other moving parts feel a bit flimsy, there's a lot rather thin plastic parts, and the overall feel is not solid. That said, there's been no cause for complaint, yet. In fact, of the three Profile appliances we bought for a kitchen remodel, this one is the standout, exceeding expectations, unlike the induction range/oven (just OK) and the Advantium "combo-oven", which does nothing well and has been a huge disappointment - but that's another review. Full marks for the dishwasher!

Sentence (English): This is a big washer.
Comments (English): [ Long cycle times, but cleans well and very quietly ] || ---------------- || This is a big washer. Much wider and deeper than my last one, which I was not expecting. It was delivered with care and I didn't experience any problem with that.Once connected, I tested it out with a towel. This washer is made mostly for liquid detergent, as I was previously using powder but found that the detergent tray was too small for even a half scoop (I've since switched to liquid). The tray itself is easy to locate and opens/closed very easily. No problem there.Once started, the regular washing cycle takes about 1h20m, which is longer than my last machine which only took about 55m, but again, it was a smaller machine. Once you press start, or play, the door locks and takes quite a long time to get started. It sort of just sits idle for almost a minute before any water begins rushing through. Once filled, the agitator starts moving, but only completes a single 360 before changing its direction and doing another 360, incredibly slowly. I initially thought it was broken or the load was somehow too heavy, but this is how it works. Its silent because it doesnt agitate quickly or splash water around at fast speeds.Make no mistake, the clothes still get clean, it iust takes long. The spin cycle goes as fast as expected and still relatively quiet.Overall, it's bigger than it seems (I can fit a weeks' worth of clothes, a large towel, and my pillow cases before I feel like anything more would be too much. I'm not a gambler) and might surprise you at how slow it goes and how long a regular cycle takes, but it's quieter than any other washer I've owned and still cleans as well as them too. If noise and vibration are your biggesg concern, and not time, then this is the machine for you

Comments (English): [ So far it's just great ] || ---------------- || I'm pretty sure I read every review on this page before buying this washer and I found that all the complaints and issues that people have had are all user errors. The installation took me maybe an hour. It was exactly like any other dishwasher I've ever installed. The hook ups are all the same and in the exact same places. No problem. Hardest part was leveling it. This would be the leak issue that people have mentioned. If you don't level the machine correctly, it will leak. Just like every dishwasher. The rinse aid error that people have complained about is as simple as turning off the rise aid option. The manual and Google both tell you how to do that. The drying issue that people mentioned is related to the rinse aid level. Adjust that for higher humidity climates and use rinse aid and you'll have no problem. It's not the quietest washer I've ever been around but it's certainly not the loudest. Level it correctly and it doesn't shake or rattle. The silverware holder snaps onto the side of the drawer exactly the same way my old Samsung washer did. It ships in the back of the drawer and I don't think people realize that that's not where it goes. Again, there is a picture of how to load in the manual. So far this thing runs just great. Consumer Reports lists this as their top pick for budget washer and I would agree with them. People having problems, read your manual. That's why they gave it to you

Sentence (English): Very quiet, you can barely hear it running.

Sentence (English): Pros: - Water softener works very well. -
Comments (English): [ Nice but lacking common sense features. ] || ---------------- || Pros: - Water softener works very well. - Stainless interior - 3rd utensil rack helpful. - Fantastic cleaning; strong spray arms. Hot temperatures - Quiet compared to my previous dishwasherCons: - Poor utilization of space - Bottom Utensil tray takes up too much space. - No sound notification when dishwasher left open. - Buttons feel really cheap. For some weird reason the two buttons you use most, on/off and start are unlighted. Just strange. Why do you even need an on/off button? It's an implied on when you select a load. - Tab catcher/dispenser takes away space from middle rack. - Drying is sub-par - There are no indicators like "rinse" or "drying" phases. Sentence (English): A 12-person dishwasher for 500,000 won.
Comments (English): [ Good value for money. ] || ---------------- || A 12-person dishwasher for 500,000 won. I bought it with half doubt because the reviews were good for the ridiculous price. I was using a 6-person one before, but the 12-person one is so big that it can hold 4-5 times more dishes instead of 2. It washes well. However, as someone who has experience, I can tell you that the detergent is the number one factor in cleaning power. There is definitely a reason it is cheap. The button operation is old-fashioned (but I like it better than the touch type), and I think it was manufactured in 2020. It smells a lot like burnt rubber when operating at high temperatures. I wonder why no one mentioned it in the reviews. They say it will be fine after a few cycles, but the smell is still too strong. Please keep this in mind when purchasing.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher in 2020 and after about a year, it started making a very loud noise when water was going into it.
Comments (English): [ Became defective quickly ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher in 2020 and after about a year, it started making a very loud noise when water was going into it. Since it was just over a year, we no longer had a warranty so we hired a technician to come and check it. The technician assessed the dishwasher and said there was an issue with the water pump that delivers water to the dishwasher and would be $450 to replace. We opted not to fix it as it was still working but just much louder than it should be. Fast forward to now and it still makes a very loud noise every time we run it which is incredibly frustrating because we paid $1,000 for this dishwasher and chose it because it was supposed to be (and initially was) very quiet. We contacted Bosch who said there was nothing that could be done since it was over a year old. However, I think a $1,000 dishwasher should last longer than a year. Would not recommend this product or any other Bosch products based on the malfunction and the poor customer service.

Sentence (English): My wife and I have decided that upgrading our dishwasher will be the first thing we do in any new home we buy!
Comments (English): [ We're forever ruined! ] || ---------------- || My wife and I have decided that upgrading our dishwasher will be the first thing we do in any new home we buy! We bought this to replace a 23 year old Bosch that finally gave out. We're on a well with hard water and our dishes always had white buildup and didn't always come as clean as we'd like (the Bosch was already 17 years old when we bought the house). Since installing this new dishwasher, it's almost become a game to see just how dirty we can put our dishes in and get away with it, and honestly, as long as the water flow isn't restrited (dishes touching), they come out spotless no matter how bad they go in! We've completely stopped pre-washing, which means all the kids of any age can toss their dishes in, and all we have to do is spot-check and start - no more "doing dishes" chore! And the built-in water softener has been fixing the issues with our dishes - even older dishes that had the white buildup are coming out with less of it each time. The 3rd rack is also a real game changer - sometimes we fill it up with silverware if we don't have room for the basket, or other times we'll fill it with measuring cups, ramekins, utensils, or whatever other smaller odd items we have. The projection of the time remaining on the floor is a good touch since it's completely silent. Install was super easy - I did it myself having never done one before and it went quick. The wifi alerts on my phone are somewhat handy; better Alexa integration would be nice - like my GE Washer which can trigger an alert on my units - but that can be added in the future. All in all I have zero complaints, and I haven't even gotten into the advanced features of the unit such as targeted zones for better cleaning or any of the other modes aside from the basic "auto" function.

I bought it as a gift for Parents' Day, but it broke down before Parents' Day. It has been used twice. There was a leak in the machine itself, so the floor was soaking wet, and the service center technician tried to fix it for 2 hours, but it didn't work, so the technician decided to refund it. My mother said that the electronic product she used twice broke down, so she was scared to use it even if it was repaired, and she lost interest in it. The response from the Samsung service center was also disappointing. I applied at 9 am on the same day, but they said they would come the next day? I would understand if it was just a simple malfunction, but how can they say they would come the next day when there is a leak? At first, my mother called, but when I called, she promised to send it as soon as possible, so a service technician came that day (the technician who came was very kind). However, I am very disappointed with the response from the Samsung service center. I wish they would hurry up and give me a refund.

Sentence (English): I recently had the privilege of having the KitchenAid 44 DBA Dishwasher with FreeFlex Third Rack and LED Interior Lighting installed, and I am beyond impressed!
Comments (English): [ Top Tier Dishwashing (especially with the Third Rack! ) ] || ---------------- || I recently had the privilege of having the KitchenAid 44 DBA Dishwasher with FreeFlex Third Rack and LED Interior Lighting installed, and I am beyond impressed! This dishwasher is beyond any dishwasher I have ever owned (or operated for that matter) in every sense. The sleek design and quality build of this dishwasher add a touch of elegance to my kitchen. It beautifully fits and also stands out with its stainless steel finish (which also has a PrintShield coating on it that makes it easy to clean in no time with a soft cloth! ). The dishwasher itself is incredibly spacious and versatile as it offers a FreeFlex Third Rack, which allows me to load items that typically wouldn't fit in a third rack, such as glasses, cups, and even larger utensils. This also helps with drying as water doesn't pool in the bottoms, providing just enough of a lean! Truly what didn't they think of? The adjustable rack height makes it easy to accommodate tall items in the lower racks without any hassle. There are also utensil baskets that can be moved around or taken out completely to fit everything comfortably.The LED interior lighting is also a fantastic feature. It illuminates the entire dishwasher, making loading and unloading so much easier, especially in low-light conditions.I instantly noticed the noise-level when running the very first load, this dishwasher is incredibly quiet! At 44 DBA, it runs almost silently, which is perfect for open-concept living spaces. I'm shocked at how incredibly quiet it is! No more waiting for company to leave to run it, but if you do want to do that, there's a setting where the dishwasher will run at a time convenient for you. Its cleaning performance is also outstanding. Every load comes out sparkling clean, from heavily soiled pots and pans to delicate glassware. The ProWash Cycle adapts to the level of cleaning required, ensuring optimal results every time. I also appreciate the energy efficiency of this model. It not only saves water but will also help reduce my energy bills. The intuitive controls and easy-to-read display make selecting cycles and options a breeze.The KitchenAid 44 DBA Dishwasher with FreeFlex Third Rack and LED Interior Lighting has by FAR exceeded my expectations. It combines style, functionality, and top-notch performance, making it a must-have for any modern kitchen. Highly recommended! I am over the moon excited to have such a beautiful dishwasher with incredible functionality. I will 100% be looking into other KitchenAid appliances!

Sentence (English): Perhaps most importantly this dishwasher cleans better, faster and more quietly than any dishwasher I've ever experienced.
Comments (English): Perhaps most importantly this dishwasher cleans better, faster and more quietly than any dishwasher I've ever experienced. It gets even the stickiest granola, dried avocado, cooked egg, etc, all off without any pre-washing/rinsing. With our previous dishwasher, those were the culprit foods that it would never get off, even on a heavy, long cycle. The Bosch Benchmark does it on an Express 45 min wash. We haven't needed to run a Heavy or even Normal cycle yet. It's that good! On the negative side, the dishwasher is considerably smaller internally than our previous Kitchen Aid despite being the same dimensions externally. I presume this must be due to sound proofing around it and, to be clear, you can barely hear this thing running, if at all. However, this does make stacking our large plates with rim a challenge. There also aren't really any wider slots for our bowl plates and silicone baby bowl/plates. There also does not appear to be anywhere to clean straws which was quite useful on our old Kitchen Aid. Overall, the cleaning power and quietness is extremely impressive and that's probably far more important than the smaller size and issues fitting larger items in the racks. I'm tempted to give it 4 stars for the stacking issues we have with it, but I think the cleaning power alone bumps it up to a solid 5. On the delivery side, Home Depot was very poor. We were given no time slot the day before as promised. I had to call on the day and was given a 2pm to 10pm slot - just an insane amount of time to have to sit around on a Saturday. The installers failed to level the dishwasher properly and installed it very obviously leaning at an angle out from the countertops. They also failed to connect the drain line properly so it started leaking after our first cycle. I called customer service who sent out another crew to repair it several days later (not even the next day or 2 days later). Again, I was given no time slot the previous day as promised - just 2 guys banging on the front door at (I kid you not) 6:20am. Okay, I'm up with my kids by then, but this is still a totally unreasonable time for a repair crew to show up, especially without warning. They couldn't find the leak and failed to fix it. They also didn't speak any English at all and we had to run everything through a translate app on a phone. The same day I ran the dishwasher and filmed where the leak was coming from (where the drain attaches to the countertop/overflow valve). Hoping another crew will show up today and put this to bed, but overall a really poor delivery experience.

With our previous dishwasher, those were the culprit foods that it would never get off, even on a heavy, long cycle. The Bosch Benchmark does it on an Express 45 min wash. We haven't needed to run a Heavy or even Normal cycle yet. It's that good! On the negative side, the dishwasher is considerably smaller internally than our previous Kitchen Aid despite being the same dimensions externally. I presume this must be due to sound proofing around it and, to be clear, you can barely hear this thing running, if at all. However, this does make stacking our large plates with rim a challenge. There also aren't really any wider slots for our bowl plates and silicone baby bowl/plates. There also does not appear to be anywhere to clean straws which was quite useful on our old Kitchen Aid. Overall, the cleaning power and quietness is extremely impressive and that's probably far more important than the smaller size and issues fitting larger items in the racks. I'm tempted to give it 4 stars for the stacking issues we have with it, but I think the cleaning power alone bumps it up to a solid 5. On the delivery side, Home Depot was very poor. We were given no time slot the day before as promised. I had to call on the day and was given a 2pm to 10pm slot - just an insane amount of time to have to sit around on a Saturday. The installers failed to level the dishwasher properly and installed it very obviously leaning at an angle out from the countertops. They also failed to connect the drain line properly so it started leaking after our first cycle. I called customer service who sent out another crew to repair it several days later (not even the next day or 2 days later). Again, I was given no time slot the previous day as promised - just 2 guys banging on the front door at (I kid you not) 6:20am. Okay, I'm up with my kids by then, but this is still a totally unreasonable time for a repair crew to show up, especially without warning. They couldn't find the leak and failed to fix it. They also didn't speak any English at all and we had to run everything through a translate app on a phone. The same day I ran the dishwasher and filmed where the leak was coming from (where the drain attaches to the countertop/overflow valve). Hoping another crew will show up today and put this to bed, but overall a really poor delivery experience.

The first person just turns it over to the NEXT person who has 24-48 hrs to call us back to continue in THE PROCESS of having someone come replace my 19 day old brand new Dishwasher. Sentence (English): I've been using it for about three months now.
Comments (English): [ It seems like a product that stays true to the basics. ] || ---------------- || I've been using it for about three months now. It seems like a product that's true to the basics. It seems to have all the functions I need as a beginner. ^^. However, the exterior (front) looks a little cheap. I took off one star ^^;

Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is our 3rd Bosch dishwasher, love the top tray for big spoons and spatulas, or else if we have lots of pots and pans, we'll use it for silverware, and load the bottom tray up and remove the silverware caddy. You can put a lot of dishes and glasses into this dishwasher! We always use the Auto Air feature, which pops the door open when it's done so it can air dry the dishes. It's quiet and a red light illuminates on the floor indicating that it's running. The door does have a tight fit when you open or close it which is not a big deal. The only negative thing I could say is that Bosch gives you a really small silverware caddy. Thank goodness we kept our old one (see pic) which is over twice the size. Not sure why they did this, maybe they're assuming you're putting all your silverware on the top tray which we don't always use, we accumulate a lot of silverware throughout the day, and it's easy to pull the caddy out and bring it over to the drawers to unload. Besides that, great dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ Innovative design that beats Miele and Bosch ] || ---------------- || My wife and I looked at Miele, Bosch, and other higher end dishwashers. But nothing beat the flexibility and innovative layout of the three racks in this KitchenAid dishwasher. We've been using it for a month now and are very happy with it. Key advantages:1. The top rack is really useful. It provides a spot for 10 dirty cups/glasses. That frees up space for other items in the main rack. The top rack also has an area for large, flat utensil like kitchen knives, spatulas, etc. Perfect.2. The main and bottom racks have plenty of room for the remaining dirty dishes. We prefer the removable cutlery holder over competing dishwashers that use the top rack, non-removable rack for cutlery. Plus the Miele and Bosch racks are smaller. Overall, we're finding that this dishwasher can hold way more dishes than our old dishwasher.3. Super quiet.4. We actually find the lights in the interior to be very useful! I'm happy we paid a little more for this feature. It's easier to place and retrieve specific items with the well-lit interior.5. I prefer the traditional North American drying system over the "more efficient" but less effective European drying systems of the Miele and Bosch. Dishes come out completely dry.6. Importantly, our dishes are all coming out clean.7. My wife loves the indicator LED on the front. Blue for cleaning. Red for drying. White for done. Plus there is a countdown digital timer on the top edge of the door.8. We added an extended warranty for a total of 5 years of coverage.

Sentence (English): So far this dishwasher has been nothing short of amazing.
Comments (English): [ Does a great job while be quiet and efficient ] || ---------------- || So far this dishwasher has been nothing short of amazing. It's quiet enough so we don't hear it run overnight (our bedroom is directly above the kitchen), and when we're in the same room we aren't having to raise our voices to speak over its noise level. The only real noise is when it's draining, which is to be expected of any dishwasher.As far as cleaning goes, I've thrown everything I can think of at it while using the various washing cycles. The steam function is great when you have things that have been caked on for a few days before washing, such as forks coated with dried parmesan cheese. The third rack does a decent enough job for things that don't have anything caked on. I wouldn't recommend it for the aforementioned forks, but things that are put freshly used before washing will be cleaned well. The bottle jets are great and really do a good job of cleaning stubborn bottles.There hasn't been any need to pre-rinse any dishes before loading and running the dishwasher. The steam function works great to break up caked on food, so if you load as you go but don't run it until the dishwasher is full, this solves that issue. We do composting, so I can't speak to how the built in disposal works for large chunks of food.The app is very functional and does a great job explaining the cycles. One of the best features via the app is that you can set it to use only the top or the bottom rack when doing a load. That way, if you only want to fill half the dishwasher you can make sure it's only using water where needed instead. The reason for not getting 5 stars on cycle options is that some of the options, such as the top/bottom rack option, bottle jet, and silverware tray jets, only seem to be available via the app. In addition, the top controls don't do a great job explaining how to set them, and the documentation is lacking on some of the hidden options which bring it in parity with the app. If you don't want to use an app, I'd recommend looking into if you can access all the features you want via the control panel.

Comments (English): [ Ultra Quiet Sleek Dishwasher Review ] || ---------------- || Starting off this kitchenaid dishwasher looks very aesthetically pleasing, with a sleek integrated grab point. This might be a negative if you like to hang towels on the handle like we used to but we'll get used to it. Stainless steel finish looks nice and should hold up well. Opening the dishwasher you've got three racks. One on the bottom for plates and larger items with an integrated silverware rack that can be taken out. The next one above can fit glasses, mugs and maybe some pans. And a smaller shelf up top that will have bigger utensils or pot lids facing down. It's nice to have that maximization of space. The racks slide smoothly and have a nice branded handle on them. There is also an LED light inside so you can see where you're putting things if it's dark. Nice detail. On the door of the dishwasher is the door where you put in your detergent. This leads us to the first con, I tried to use a powder dishwasher and you have to make sure you do not overfill at all otherwise it is very difficult to close the detergent door. Pods or a liquid dish detergent would work best for this. When you're ready to wash, you use the touch sensitive buttons on the top of the door to select what type of wash you want, and what kind of drying cycle you want. It will show you the time required in total on the small screen. This is a nice detail I appreciate. Another con is how sensitive these buttons are however, as I found myself accidentally touching them as I opened the dishwasher or even when it's open if your leg touches them they could go off. You have to choose something then press start to actually begin washing so it's hard to accidentally start a cycle but not impossible. I kinda wish they just had physical buttons, but the touch buttons are something I can get used to. I typically always do short washes and short drying. When the washer is running, it is very very quiet, as shown in the video. I was watching TV in the other room and could not hear it at all. The drying cycle is quiet as well. The dishes came out very clean, as expected. Overall, I'd say this is a very well made dishwasher. It's got some ergonomic changes I would make, such as the detergent door and the touch buttons, but it functions flawlessly and leaves my dishes looking spotless. I would definitely consider KitchenAid if I needed a dishwasher in the future.
